content.title: About
content.content: Boost is a ready‑to‑drink nutritional shake designed to support energy and recovery after physical activity. It provides a balanced blend of proteins, carbohydrates, vitamins, minerals, and performance‑enhancing ingredients such as creatine and L‑glutamine.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Boost was first launched in 2015 as part of a sports‑nutrition line.
Each serving delivers 20 g of protein sourced from whey and soy.
The drink uses natural flavors and sweeteners with no added sugar.
The formula is fortified with B‑vitamins that aid energy metabolism.
Boost is available in several flavors: chocolate, vanilla, strawberry and banana.

items.title: Supports muscle recovery
items.content: Protein and amino acids help accelerate repair of muscle fibers after workouts.

items.title: Provides an energy boost
items.content: Low‑glycemic carbs and B‑vitamins promote a steady level of energy.

items.title: Boosts immunity
items.content: Vitamin C and zinc support the immune system, especially during periods of high stress.

items.title: Hydration support
items.content: Electrolytes (sodium, potassium, magnesium) help maintain fluid balance.

items.title: Supports bone health
items.content: Calcium and vitamin D contribute to maintaining bone density.

items.title: Milk‑protein allergy
items.content: Contains whey protein, which may trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Caffeine content
items.content: Some flavors are fortified with caffeine; caffeine‑sensitive persons should limit intake.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: Certain variants use sucralose or stevia, which can cause gastrointestinal discomfort for some people.

items.title: Not suitable for children
items.content: Due to high protein and additive levels, the drink is recommended for adults and teens over 14 years old.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Shake the bottle well before drinking and consume immediately after mixing. Recommended dosage is 1–2 servings per day, depending on activity level and caloric needs.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, keep refrigerated and consume within 48 hours.
